mostWorthwhile.text: Building the living bone cutaway was most worthwhile: the planned pictures distinguish collagen and mineral, embedded cells, and blood supply rather than presenting bone as inert material.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the capsule was fairly predictable after lining the sleeve, although the fluid explanation clarified its purpose.

surprise.text: The lineage picture showed matrix-producing osteoblasts becoming embedded osteocytes, an interesting connection between bone formation and mature tissue.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless. The lineage inset names mesodermal and mesenchymal precursors without explaining them, though, so that part of the transition was less clear than the assembly.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the bone and joint constructions connected structure to function clearly, and I would be curious to see how muscles act on the completed skeleton.
